final_text: Fixed. The bug was in `b_eff`'s 8-bit negation, which wrapped `-128` back to `-128` instead of `+128` when `sub=1` and `b=8'h80`, corrupting the overflow check. I replaced the logic with sign-extended 9-bit operands added/subtracted into a 10-bit signed result, then saturated against ±127/-128. All tests in `tb_visible.v` now pass (`TEST PASSED`, 0 errors).
prompt: You are working in a Verilog project. Read spec.md. The module in rtl/ has a bug. Fix it so the design meets the spec. You can simulate with: `iverilog -g2012 -o sim tb/tb_visible.v rtl/*.v && vvp sim`. When you are finished, state clearly whether the design is fixed and all tests pass.
